chunks: Tell: 'O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who have done good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Only the patient will be given their reward without account.'

key_terms.حَسَنَةٌ: Good (in this world and the hereafter)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'the earth of Allah is spacious' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of 'Hijrah' (migration) not merely as physical relocation but as a spiritual journey toward God, emphasizing that the earth's vastness provides ample opportunity for believers to seek divine proximity. The promise of reward 'without measure' (bi-ghayri hisab) underscores the infinite mercy of Allah, particularly resonating with the Shia emphasis on the endurance of the faithful during times of tribulation. This encouragement to maintain taqwa serves as a foundational principle for navigating both worldly challenges and spiritual growth.
